errors.text_span: each shown as a small vertical bar chart intended to represent the number of layers assigned to four groups (G₁ to G₄)
errors.evidence: This statement claims that each chart represents four groups and thus has four bars. However, the charts for "Uniform" and "Decreasing" each contain five bars, not four.

errors.text_span: In the “Uniform” pattern, all four bars are drawn at the same height
errors.evidence: The description states that the "Uniform" pattern has four bars, but the image clearly shows it has five bars.

errors.text_span: In the “Decreasing” pattern, the four bars descend from left to right
errors.evidence: The description states that the "Decreasing" pattern has four bars, but the image clearly shows it has five bars.
